paragraphs: The GLC400d was introduced with the X254 generation of the GLC-Class in 2022, slotting in as the top diesel option above the GLC220d and GLC300d. It uses the OM656 - a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel that's part of Mercedes' newer modular engine family, fitted with mild-hybrid technology from launch. Unlike the earlier X253 generation's diesel range (which relied on four-cylinder OM651 and OM654 units), the X254 GLC400d uses a six-cylinder diesel that's a genuinely different design - smoother and more powerful than its four-cylinder stablemates.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLC400D on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLC400D from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The GLC400d uses the OM656 engine exclusively, which is specific to the X254 generation. Because this engine is a recent introduction, compatibility checks matter - particularly when sourcing replacement parts or considering a used unit from another model. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic GLC-Class quote - it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
